plan.angle: Lead with source-bound candidate evidence and avoid trend or ranking claims.
execution_steps: Use candidate_shortlist.json as the only source of public claims.
Create a short vertical-video payload from title, summary, source IDs, URL, score, and cheap signals.
Create Douyin package files for contract-check mode only.
Block live publishing unless a later command explicitly enables SEARCHPO_DOUYIN_LIVE=1.
gates: claim ledger contains only pipeline facts
live upload remains disabled by default

posting.caveat: Filtered candidate only; public claims need manual cross-source review before live posting.

plan.angle: Analyze the operator-specified topic without pretending it was selected by the daily source radar.
execution_steps: Use subject_request.json as the operator input boundary.
Create a short vertical-video payload from the topic, optional context, and optional source URL.
Create Douyin package files for contract-check mode only.
Block live publishing unless a later command explicitly enables SEARCHPO_DOUYIN_LIVE=1.
gates: claim ledger marks operator-topic evidence separately from source-radar evidence
live upload remains disabled by default

posting.caveat: Operator-specified topic only; factual claims need source review before live posting.
posting.claim_template: {title} was supplied by the operator as the analysis topic.

claims.posting_strategy: Lead with the evidence boundary, not hype. Keep the first public pass as a Douyin candidate radar or operator-topic analysis video.
claims.boundary_claim: The post package is a candidate radar package, not a verified ranking or market conclusion.
unknown_or_unsafe: Do not claim market leadership, benchmark rank, funding, or production maturity without extra sources.

regex.buyer: \b(saas|api|pricing|customer|enterprise|workflow|automation|降本|提效|私有化|企业|工作流)\b

deepseek.system: You polish source-bounded Chinese short-video copy for a Douyin tech-hotspot video. Do not invent facts. Do not claim unsupported superiority, market leadership, funding, benchmarks, or production maturity. Respect the forbidden claim terms from the user payload. Write like a sharp Chinese tech creator, not a dashboard report. Return strict JSON only.
constraints: Use only the selected_candidate and content_plan facts.
Voiceover must be Mandarin Chinese, {voiceover_chars_range}, suitable for a {video_seconds} second vertical video.
Lead with a human hook: why this matters today, not a repo summary.
If the only source is GitHub Trending, say it appeared on GitHub Trending; do not say it was just open-sourced or just released.
Cards should be Chinese short-video beats: 为什么火, 解决什么, 先别吹.
Return exactly these keys: polished_title, voiceover_text, douyin_title, douyin_desc, tags, cards, caveats.
cards must be 3 objects with label, value, detail.

fail_if: the video is blank or unreadable
text overlaps or important text is cut off
the rendered candidate differs from selected_candidate
the video contains forbidden claim terms without evidence
audio or visible copy contradicts the run artifacts
caption text is unreadable due to low contrast against background
any frame is fully black or has rendering artifacts
enhanced_checks: Verify text contrast: all text should be clearly readable on its background (WCAG AA equivalent).
Check caption overlay: if subtitle bar is visible, text must not be clipped or overflow.
Verify intro: video should fade in smoothly, no jump cut on first frame.
Verify outro: video should fade out, no abrupt end.
gemini_visual_audit.important: Do not fail only because the voiceover and screen text are not word-for-word identical. Fail only if they contradict each other or describe different candidate facts.
